# Original environment fixtures

These small RWX models and the procedural 2×2 PNG pixels in `textures.ts` are original work dedicated to CC0 1.0. They are isolated test data, not assets served by the live Axis fixture. No Active Worlds model or image is redistributed.

The skybox is an inward-facing 2 m cube; its size and facing are intentional. The ground is a single 60 m panel with an authored 0.2 m elevation. Its dimensions do not establish target-build ground repetition semantics.

Primary context: Active Worlds' [skybox authoring article](https://www.activeworlds.com/newsletter/1001/1006.html) and [AWG ground article](https://www.activeworlds.com/newsletter/1012/awgs-for-ground.html). AWG groups, legacy backdrop projection, and target-build ground repetition are not implemented by these fixtures.
